title: WISDOM project - IV. A molecular gas dynamical measurement of the supermassive black hole mass in NGC 524
question: What is the SMBH mass of NGC 524 from forward-modelling the ALMA CO(2-1) molecular gas kinematics, and how do it compare with the stellar dynamical value and the M-sigma relation?

data.sensitivity: 0.5 mJy/beam in 15 km/s channels; 1.1 mJy/beam in 2 km/s channels; 0.1 mJy/beam continuum

what.value: MGE stellar light model of NGC 524 (Table 3)

evidence.quote: This MGE model was originally reported in Table B1 of (cite: Cappellari+2006MNRAS366.1126) and is reproduced in Table [3](#tab_MGE) of this work.
we adopt a distance to NGC 524 of $23.3\pm2.3\,\mathrm{Mpc}$
the dust disc seen in HST images was also found to lie at an inclination of $20\pm5\degree$ (cite: Cappellari+2006MNRAS366.1126)

what.value: Previous stellar dynamical SMBH mass 8.3e8 Msun, M/L_I=5.8

recipe.method: uvcontsub, Briggs-weighted cleaning to 15 and 2 km/s cubes; tclean MFS continuum; imfit of the nuclear source
MGE from Cappellari+2006, deprojected at disc inclination, multiplied by constant M/L; central unresolved component excluded; circular velocity from Cappellari 2002 Eq. 12
assumptions: Constant M/L across disc; central MGE component is AGN; negligible dark matter

recipe.method: Initial fit on 2 km/s cube; dispersion then fixed for 15 km/s cube fits

recipe.goal: Forward-model cube with MCMC to get SMBH mass
recipe.method: KinMS forward model of the central 6.4"x6.4" with Gibbs-sampling MCMC, chi-squared with covariance matrix; truncated exponential gas disc; fit SMBH mass, M/L, scale length, truncation radius, flux, PA, inclination, offsets
assumptions: Thin axisymmetric disc, circular motions, distance 23.3 Mpc, inclination fixed to 20 deg

recipe.method: For each MCMC model draw inclination from Gaussian (3 sigma width 5 deg) and rescale mass and M/L via M proportional to (v/sin i)^2; take median and 99.7% interval
assumptions: Inclination 20±5 deg from dust disc and tilted-ring fit

recipe.method: Sample summed CLEAN components (zeroth moment) as particles passed to KinMS via inClouds, deprojected within MCMC; rerun fixed-inclination fit
assumptions: Non-axisymmetric gas not significant to the potential

recipe.method: Residual velocity field, ridge-finding of residual spiral, MCMC with radial velocity term, kinemetry harmonic and tilted-ring fits, MCMC with PA fixed to kinemetry value

evidence.quote: Our best-fitting SMBH mass is thus $4.0^{+1.6}_{-1.5}\times10^8\,\mathrm{M_\odot}$ ($3\sigma$ formal uncertainties) with a reduced $\chi^2$ of $\chi^2_\mathrm{red} = 1.84$.

answer_key.quantity: SMBH mass including inclination uncertainty (3 sigma)

evidence.quote: Our resulting SMBH mass measurement is then $4.0^{+3.5}_{-2.0}\times 10^8\,$M$_\odot$, where the uncertainty given is at the $3\sigma$ level.
Our best-fitting mass-to-light ratio is $5.7\pm0.3\,\mathrm{\mathrm{M_\odot}/L_{\odot,I}}$ ($3\sigma$ formal uncertainties).
The best-fitting velocity dispersion is then $9.3\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$, fixed in all subsequent MCMC runs.
It has an integrated flux of $8.3\pm0.1\,\mathrm{mJy}$.

answer_key.quantity: SMBH mass with SkySampler gas distribution (fixed inclination)

evidence.quote: The resulting SMBH mass at fixed inclination is $M_\mathrm{BH} = 4.6^{+1.8}_{-1.3} \times 10^8\,$M$_\odot$ ($3\sigma$ formal uncertainties).
This yields a sphere of influence radius of $36\,\mathrm{pc}$ ($0.31\ensuremath{''}$)
A very clear spiral feature can be seen in the residuals, extending from the central hole with a peak amplitude of $\approx15\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$.

not_stated_but_needed: Smooth-masking clip threshold and cube-smoothing details for moment maps
CLEAN threshold, niter, and deconvolver used
Initial values, adaptive step settings and acceptance fraction for KinMS_MCMC
Mask used to define the fitted region in the cube and the number of pixels N
Details of the covariance matrix computation
Mask and thresholds used for ridge-finding and kinemetry settings
Rest frequency adopted and systemic velocity used for cube centring
score_reason: Public data, open code, and detailed model description, but imaging and calibration details are partly omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, fitting recipe with priors and fixed inputs is detailed, and main results are numeric.
